outcome: retinal hemorrhages (presence, location, grade, features, resolution)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 98 consecutive newborns with retinal hemorrhages and 30 control newborns without retinal hemorrhages, all after uneventful delivery.
finding: Neonatal retinal hemorrhages are commonly observed near the major vascular arcade and optic disc, are significantly associated with normal spontaneous vaginal delivery, and resolve spontaneously without impacting refractive error or strabismus development in the short term.
mod_finding: Retinal hemorrhages were significantly associated with normal spontaneous vaginal delivery (NSVD) compared to cesarean section.
